requirement.original: 检修 Spec Item 5.17 — Markdown rendering broken: H2 font size equals body text (16px, should be larger/bold); list markers `-` and `1.` render as plain text instead of <ul>/<ol>/<li> elements.
requirement.clarified: Two surgical visual fixes to packages/happy-app/sources/components/markdown/MarkdownView.tsx: (1) enlarge header1 (currently 16px = body) and header3 (currently 16px = body) so all heading fontSize > body fontSize; (2) refactor RenderListBlock and RenderNumberedListBlock so the bullet/number marker is rendered as a separate node (not literal text inside the same <Text> as the item content). Optionally add web-semantic accessibilityRole='list'/'listitem' / 'header' for <ul>/<ol>/<li>/<h1..6>.
requirement.what: Fix header font-size collapse and list-marker leak in MarkdownView.tsx
requirement.why: User-visible bug §5.17: H2 visually identical to body (only weight differs); lists display literal `-` / `1.` characters as if markdown source leaked through, even though the parser already detects them correctly.

included: packages/happy-app/sources/components/markdown/MarkdownView.tsx — header1/header3 (and optionally header4-6) fontSize raise; RenderListBlock + RenderNumberedListBlock marker-as-separate-node refactor; optional accessibilityRole web semantic
excluded: Parser changes (parseMarkdown.ts / parseMarkdownBlock.ts / parseMarkdownSpans.ts) — already correct, verified live
Other §5.17 primitives that PASSED in prior cycle (blockquote, task-list, kbd, strikethrough, bold, italic, link, inline code, code-block, table, LaTeX, Mermaid)
Task list interactive checkbox <input> — separate carry-forward
Demo-prompt seed (QA's job to add a `### 三级标题` line for full H3 coverage)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: User: H2 字号 = 正文（16px），应该加大加粗到 H1 那种层级。列表 `-`/`1.` 完全没渲染成 ul/ol/li。
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Two distinct L1 (cosmetic) defects in MarkdownView.tsx: (1) header1 / header3..6 styles all have fontSize: 16 — equal to body, only fontWeight differentiates; (2) RenderListBlock writes literal '- ' inside <Text> content at line 176, RenderNumberedListBlock writes literal '{n}. ' at line 209. The dash and number characters are part of the rendered text node, indistinguishable from raw markdown source. Parser is INNOCENT — verified live: it correctly detects headings (level 1-6) and produces 'list' / 'numbered-list' blocks; the wrapper <View> is rendered correctly with class unistyles_2agt3r2nu7s.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — original implementation; no regression. Production /root/happy has identical bug.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original markdown renderer was minimal; literal '- ' was the simplest text-node approach to show a bullet without React Native list semantics. Headers were sized for compact chat-message display.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: (1) Visual collapse: with only fontWeight to differentiate H1/H3-6 from body, screen-reader-less users with subtle weight rendering perceive heading as bold paragraph, not heading. (2) Marker leak: the literal '- ' and '1. ' inside textContent looks identical to raw markdown source — directly produces user complaint '列表 - 漏成纯文本'. Affects accessibility (no <ul>/<ol>/<li> for screen readers) and visual hierarchy.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Defect present since the markdown renderer was first introduced (commit 7f178466, Jan 2026 per prior BA spec). 2026-04-24 cycle (dev-report-20260424-143000-0) added blockquote / task-list / nested depth / kbd / strikethrough / HTML entity decode but did not modify existing header1..6 styles or list-marker emission.

attempts.proposed_solution: Add 7 missing primitives — strikethrough, task-list, nested-list depth, blockquote, kbd, HTML entity decode; ensure no regression on existing primitives.
attempts.actual_change: 4 files modified — parseMarkdown.ts (added 'strikethrough'/'kbd' to span styles, 'task-list'/'blockquote' to block types, depth field on list items), parseMarkdownSpans.ts (added ~~ and <kbd> regexes + entity decode), parseMarkdownBlock.ts (refactored monolith into ParseCtx + 12 helpers; added blockquote / task-list / nested-depth branches), MarkdownView.tsx (added RenderTaskListBlock + RenderBlockquoteBlock; updated RenderListBlock for depth indent).
attempts.outcome: Blockquote, task-list, kbd, strikethrough, nested-list depth all PASS per QA-20260425-131502. But H1/H2/H3 typography NOT changed (header1/3..6 still 16px = body); list-marker emission NOT changed (literal '- ' / '{n}. ' still in Text content); 100% of list items still leak markdown source.
attempts.why_failed: Spec MoSCoW R6 said 'existing headings/ordered lists must NOT regress' but never required them to MEET the AC font-size>body rule. AC only specified marker-indent for nested lists, not marker-distinct-from-text-content. So implementation correctly held to the literal under-ask while leaving the actual AC-failing behaviour intact.

novelty_check.rationale: Attempt 1 was additive (new branches, new components, new types — all GREEN-FIELD code). This attempt MODIFIES EXISTING code: existing header1..6 fontSize values, existing RenderListBlock and RenderNumberedListBlock marker-emission lines. Different lines (545-582, 176, 209 vs Attempt 1's added lines around 165-200), different intent (fix existing renderer behaviour vs add new branches), no overlap with Attempt 1's modifications. Layer is L1 in both cases but the surface area is disjoint.
